events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit on main, remote divergence, publish hold
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 5be6f60 main && echo ON_MAIN; git fetch -q origin && git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; git log -1 --format=%h main; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; ls /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/ | grep -i -E "deploy|clean"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin state and deploy runbook
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 5be6f60 origin/main && echo ON_ORIGIN; git log --oneline origin/main..main; cat /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/centre-deploy-clean-worktree.md | head -40; grep -n "T-261\|revops-centre deployed" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check later deploys and migrations
events.input: $ grep -n "DEPLOYED\|Worker [0-9a-f]\{8\}" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -8 | cut -c1-400; ls cloud/migrations | tail -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether later deploys include T-261
events.input: $ for c in f6451e2 147b841 97096ab; do git merge-base --is-ancestor 5be6f60 $c && echo "$c contains"; done; git diff --stat 5be6f60 main -- cloud/src/jobs.ts cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts cloud/src/agentic.ts cloud/src/connectors/cloudflare.ts | tail -2; git status --porcelain cloud/ | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header and recent log
events.input: $ sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs; git show --stat --format=%s 49078bf | tail -3; tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300

events.text: Quick status: 5be6f60 is already on origin/main, and the live Worker (7f8bfc45, deployed from 97096ab) already contains it. Now I'm rerunning tsc and the probe to confirm.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run DNS-elsewhere probe and typecheck
events.input: $ git status --porcelain cloud/src cloud/scripts app/src/lib | head; node cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs 2>&1 | tail -25; (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc_exit=$?)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look at zone activation in sim and jobs
events.input: $ grep -n "active\|pending" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -20; grep -n "cfAddZone\|cfZoneStatus\|pending\|export async function cf.*Zone" cloud/src/connectors/cloudflare.ts | head; grep -n "pending\|cfAddZone\|zoneActive\|nameservers" cloud/src/jobs.ts | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect sim activation and probe body
events.input: $ sed -n 55,72p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; grep -n "ACTIVE_AFTER_S\s*=\|\"delegation\"\|S\[\"delegations\"\]\|ns_at" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head; sed -n 30,75p cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs; sed -n 100,135p cloud/src/connectors/cloudflare.ts; grep -n "export async function cf\(Dns\|Upsert\|Put\|Record\)" cloud/src/connectors/cloudflare.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find sim nameserver setter endpoints
events.input: $ grep -n '\["ns"\] = \|\["ns_at"\] = ' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head; grep -n '"/__' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read sim NS-change route and cfUpsert
events.input: $ sed -n 1915,1935p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; sed -n 3655,3668p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; sed -n 137,165p cloud/src/connectors/cloudflare.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check zone_view usage and record names
events.input: $ grep -n "zone_view(" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; grep -n "resend._domainkey\|send\.\${\|feedback-smtp\|_dmarc" cloud/src/jobs.ts | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun extended probe
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|zone turns|Day 0|ALL PASS|FAILED"; node cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git diff --name-only cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py cloud/scripts/probe-dns-elsewhere.mjs
